description: AI Agent. This is a computer program. It works on its own. It does not always need instructions from people. The AI agent perceives its environment. It recognizes tasks on its own. It makes a plan. Then it works through the plan. Some AI agents learn from their experiences. They get better over time. But not all AI agents learn. Some simply follow fixed rules. AI agents can do many different things. They can speak, write, and calculate. They can also look at images and understand them.
example: An AI agent helps customers on the phone. It hears that the customer is upset. The agent understands the problem. It suggests a solution. If needed it calls a person for help. It does all of this on its own, without anyone telling it what to do.
